notes: Reach stated as 100 m on OM4/M5F MMF and 70 m on OM3/M5E MMF (converted to km in reach_km). C-temp SKUs: 0°C to 70°C; E-temp SKUs: 0°C to 85°C (temp_max_c uses highest stated operating maximum). Stressed receiver OMA sensitivity -5.2 dBm @ 25.78 Gb/s and -7.5 dBm @ 10.3 Gb/s (dual rate) at BER 5E-5; unstressed OMA sensitivity -11.1 dBm @ 10.3 Gb/s is informative. Average receive power min -10.3 dBm @ 25.78 Gb/s is informative. Total power dissipation may exceed 1 W when establishing link at case temperature below 25°C. Receiver damage threshold 3.4 dBm (tolerance without damage; correct operation not required). Transmitter dispersion penalty (TDP) max 3.9 dB @ 10.3 Gb/s; TDEC max 4.3 dB @ 25.7 Gb/s. Spectral width (RMS) max 0.60 nm. Launch power in OMA minus TDEC -7.3 dBm. Average launch power of OFF transmitter max -30 dBm.
provenance_datasheet_sections: III. Electrical Characteristics (TA, VCC = 3.15 to 3.46 Volts)
suggestions: Add SFP28/SFP+ to form_factor enum. Consider reach_m or allow reach with unit in notes to avoid m-to-km conversion. Include OMA and stressed/unstressed sensitivity as distinct schema fields if needed.
